changelog: - **Renaming keeps the run.** A name is not part of what a run computes, and renaming a node already left the run where it was. Renaming an imported Parameter, renaming a data table in Manage bindings, and undoing or redoing any rename, a plain Parameter's included, still sent the run back to step 0 and marked a finished Monte Carlo result out of date, which turned off its export. They now keep both. The rename is still one Undo step, is saved, and marks an open project revision as changed. Changing a value still resets the run, as before.
